description: Read the stored evidence for one exact x402 endpoint URL: price, payment networks, liveness, delivery history and risk flags. It never calls or pays the endpoint itself. Use it before paying an endpoint you already know, for example one returned by recommend; use recommend instead to find candidates for a task. Pass url exactly as listed: paths and trailing slashes are distinct. Use view=compact for essentials only. Demo endpoints are free; other indexed endpoints cost 1% of the endpoint's lowest quoted price, minimum 0.001 USDC. An unindexed URL returns ENDPOINT_NOT_INDEXED without payment. Pays only if the wallet owner set AGENTS_TRUST_ENABLE_PAYMENTS=true and AGENTS_TRUST_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY (Base USDC): one paid call per process, at most AGENTS_TRUST_MAX_CALL_USDC (default 0.01), never retried. Otherwise it errors without paying; errors and empty results are free. Returns JSON {data, payment_attempt_id, request_id}; payment_attempt_id is set only after a paid answer, for use with receipt. data.endpoint holds price (min_usd, max_usd), networks and payment_offers, liveness (is_live, last probe time; compact and evidence views), delivery_verification (status, charged and charged-not-delivered counts), risk_flags and invocation (request schema); data.lookup shows the canonical URL matched.

url.description: Exact public HTTPS endpoint URL, including any fixed query parameters, e.g. a pick's url from recommend. Private, malformed and credential-bearing URLs are rejected before payment.

view.description: Response detail: compact (smallest), evidence (full evidence blocks), legacy (default, original field layout) or debug (adds diagnostic fields).

name: inspect
title: Inspect evidence for one endpoint
